title: Signed pair assignment review
software_contract: score(values,pairs)=sum(w if values[i]!=values[j] else -w). choose(size,pairs) maximizes this over all Boolean vectors; ties smallest numeric mask. Valid complete undirected pairs i<j with w in {-1,+1}; no mutation. Newly authored exact enumeration, not the upstream variational optimizer.
input_domain: Valid kernel arguments as specified; application validation and reports are not part of this core view.
execution_assumptions: Classical inputs and outputs; no workload, quantum hardware, encoding-cost or advantage evidence supplied.
